name: Waza (Berta gourd-trumpet ensemble)
lineage: Ensemble music of the Berta people of the Blue Nile borderlands of Sudan and Ethiopia, played on waza, end-blown trumpets built from joined gourd segments. Sets of many differently sized and tuned trumpets are each blown by one player sounding a single tone, so that melodies are assembled in hocket at communal celebrations; the bigwala card, another single-tone gourd-trumpet set, stands in for the waza.
recipe: classic modern waza, groove Percussion, central east south African branch, wind pipe drone modal. single tone per player hocket gourd trumpets bigwala trumpets. field recording. ORTF stereo pair, portable field-recorder pre. 24-bit digital.
